THE_ARCHITECT.talk.ACHERON-ACHERON_CHARA: Another one treads the tower. Exiled bladesbearer, for whom do you come?
For no one. Only — to sever every cause, and gaze upon the void.
This tower is woven of eternity. How many floors can one blade cut?
The tower still stands. I cut too shallow last time.
Order does not break by a single stroke. You loop in vain.
Looping is itself causality — and that is what I have come to sever.
Each return, the karma on your blade grows heavier.
Slashed Dream runs thin. Time to let this tower see its true end.
